title: Variational Filtering for Bayesian Last Layers with an Independent Binary Probit Surrogate
abstract: arXiv:2610.16578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern deep classifiers trained by gradient descent need many passes over the data to become accurate, and even then are not always well calibrated; post-hoc temperature scaling corrects calibration after training but cannot influence training-time accuracy or convergence. We propose a variational filtering algorithm for the last layer of deep classifiers, whose parameters are treated as the latent state of a linear-Gaussian state-space model. Each mini-batch is assimilated by an exact prediction step followed by a closed-form variational update, made conjugate by an independent binary probit (IBProbit) surrogate for the categorical likelihood. The filter's process noise stabilises the updates under feature drift and keeps the predictive distribution from collapsing to a point estimate, allowing the same procedure to be used for linear probing on a frozen backbone and for full-network fine-tuning. translated_title: 基于独立二元Probit替代似然的贝叶斯末层变分滤波
translated_abstract: 通过梯度下降训练的现代深度分类器需要对数据进行多次遍历才能获得较高准确率，即便如此其校准性也未必良好；事后温度缩放虽可在训练后修正校准，却无法影响训练过程中的准确率或收敛性。我们为深度分类器的最后一层提出了一种变分滤波算法，将该层参数视为线性高斯状态空间模型的隐状态。每个小批量数据通过一个精确的预测步骤和随后的闭式变分更新被同化，其中通过为类别似然引入独立二元Probit（IBProbit）替代模型实现共轭性。滤波器的过程噪声在特征漂移下稳定了更新过程，并防止预测分布坍缩为点估计，使得同一流程既可用于冻结骨干网络上的线性探测，也可用于全网络微调。我们在 DINOv3 骨干网络上进行评估（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了一种将深度分类器末层参数视为线性高斯状态空间模型隐状态的变分滤波算法，借助独立二元Probit替代似然实现闭式共轭更新，可在特征漂移下稳定训练并同时适用于线性探测与全网络微调。
en_tdlr: A variational filtering algorithm treats deep classifier last-layer parameters as the latent state of a linear-Gaussian state-space model, using an independent binary probit surrogate likelihood for closed-form conjugate updates that remain stable under feature drift and support both linear probing and full-network fine-tuning.
